description: Phase-1.5 in-distribution discrimination check (F-1.5.4): ROC curves on the labeled synthetic held-out validation set, one per model, each annotated with its AUROC. The companion to the F-1.5.3 realism bars — if an intervention improved sim-realism but its curve here sits lower (AUROC drops), that's the realism-vs-discrimination trade-off worth discussing. Synthetic-only: ROC needs ground truth, which IAFDB lacks. Each group's bank is one model's predictions on the SAME synthetic val set (probs = P(fibrotic), labels = truth); the recipe reuses the prediction-histogram loader, so a bank that is unlabeled (a upred_ IAFDB bank) is rejected. 'inputs.positive_label' (default 1) selects the positive class and must match what the predictions banks were scored for. Swap in your own labeled synth-val predictions banks (one per model or variant you want to compare) when wiring real data. Renders via the 'roc-curve-multi-line' recipe.
